package web

// Generator for the "v-before" upgrade fixture. Runs ONLY at the base commit (05b1019) and only when
// FAIRY_GEN_FIXTURE names an output directory: every file is written by that release's own code, through its
// real HTTP handler, sign-in round trip and admin CLI. Not part of the repository.

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/n3ptune-cpu/Fairy-agent/pkg/devices"
	"github.com/n3ptune-cpu/Fairy-agent/pkg/ups"
	"github.com/n3ptune-cpu/Fairy-dashboard/internal/admin"
	"github.com/n3ptune-cpu/Fairy-dashboard/internal/config"
	"github.com/n3ptune-cpu/Fairy-dashboard/internal/notifications"
	"github.com/n3ptune-cpu/Fairy-dashboard/internal/poller"
	"github.com/n3ptune-cpu/Fairy-dashboard/internal/testutil"
)

const vBeforeConfig = `# config.yaml as written for the release before the security fixes: the two session values are plain
# numbers of seconds, and none of the keys added later is here.
public_url: https://panel.example.com
listen: 127.0.0.1:8080
request_timeout: 4
offline_after: 60
session_max_age: 604800
session_idle_timeout: 43200
step_up_window_s: 300
step_up_prompt_login: true
enable_docs: false
data_dir: /var/lib/fairy
audit_log: /var/lib/fairy/audit.log
audit_max_mb: 100
audit_keep: 5
control_rate_per_min: 6
login_rate_per_min: 20
trusted_proxies: ["127.0.0.1/32", "::1/128"]
panel_hosts: []
boost_while_viewing: true
intervals: {agent: 1, proxmox: 2, ups: 2, history: 5, stream: 1}
oidc:
  issuer: https://id.example.com
  client_id: cid
  scopes: [openid, profile, email, groups]
  groups_claim: groups
  allowed_groups: [homelab]
  allowed_emails: []
  control_groups: []
  bootstrap_admins: [owner@example.com]
proxmox:
  - id: teyvat
    cluster_name: NSX-TEYVAT
    site: Neptune
    urls: ["https://pve1:8006"]
    token_id: "fairy@pve!panel"
    token_secret_env: PVE_SECRET
    verify_tls: false
agents:
  - {id: laptop, url: "http://laptop", token_env: TOK_LAPTOP, group: Neptune, site: Neptune, power_control: true,
     self_update: true, control_token_env: CTL_CYRENE}
  - {id: cyrene, url: "http://cyrene", token_env: TOK_CYRENE,
     fan_control: {vendor: supermicro, control_token_env: CTL_CYRENE}}
`

func TestGenVBeforeFixture(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("FAIRY_GEN_FIXTURE")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("fixture generator: set FAIRY_GEN_FIXTURE=<dir>")
	}
	t.Setenv("TOK_LAPTOP", testutil.ReadToken)
	t.Setenv("TOK_CYRENE", testutil.ReadToken+"x")
	t.Setenv("CTL_CYRENE", testutil.ControlToken)
	t.Setenv("PVE_SECRET", "pve-secret-uuid")
	dataDir := filepath.Join(out, "data")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dataDir, 0o700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "config.yaml"), []byte(vBeforeConfig), 0o640); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg, err := config.Parse([]byte(vBeforeConfig))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg.DataDir, cfg.AuditLog = dataDir, filepath.Join(dataDir, "audit.log")
	b := testutil.NewBackend()
	secrets := config.Secrets{SessionSecret: strings.Repeat("s", 48)}
	p, err := poller.New(cfg, secrets, b)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p.PollOnce(context.Background())
	s := New(cfg, secrets, p, nil, "0.0.0-before")
	srv := httptest.NewServer(s.Handler())
	defer srv.Close()
	e := &env{t: t, s: s, srv: srv, b: b}
	idp := newFakeIDP(t)
	s.Cfg.OIDC.Issuer = idp.srv.URL

	signIn := func(sub, email, name string, extra map[string]any) string {
		idp.claims = map[string]any{"sub": sub, "email": email, "name": name, "groups": []string{"homelab"}, "auth_time": time.Now().Unix()}
		for k, v := range extra {
			idp.claims[k] = v
		}
		q, rt := idp.login(e, "/auth/login", "")
		r := e.do("GET", "/auth/callback?code=c&state="+q.Get("state"), nil, "Cookie", rt)
		if r.code != 303 {
			t.Fatal("sign-in", sub, r.code, string(r.raw))
		}
		return sessionCookie(e, r.hdr)
	}
	ok := func(what string, r resp, codes ...int) {
		for _, c := range codes {
			if r.code == c {
				return
			}
		}
		t.Fatal(what, r.code, string(r.raw))
	}

	// The owner: the first sign-in, admin through oidc.bootstrap_admins (the address was verified then).
	owner := signIn("3f6c1d2e-owner-0001", "owner@example.com", "Owner", map[string]any{"email_verified": true})
	oh := []string{"Cookie", owner, "X-Requested-With", "fairy"}
	if me := e.do("GET", "/api/me", nil, "Cookie", owner); me.code != 200 || me.body["role"] != "admin" {
		t.Fatal("owner is not admin", string(me.raw))
	}
	// a viewer, someone waiting, and someone the owner removed
	straw := signIn("9a1b77c0-straw-0002", "straw@example.com", "Straw", nil)
	signIn("5d2e9f10-kaveh-0003", "kaveh@example.com", "Kaveh", nil)
	signIn("c0ffee00-gone-0004", "gone@example.com", "Gone", nil)
	ok("site", e.do("POST", "/api/admin/sites", map[string]any{"name": "Straw"}, oh...), 200, 201)
	ok("role", e.do("PUT", "/api/admin/users/9a1b77c0-straw-0002", map[string]any{"role": "viewer", "sites": []string{"Straw"}}, oh...), 200)
	ok("remove", e.do("DELETE", "/api/admin/users/c0ffee00-gone-0004", nil, oh...), 200)
	ok("assign", e.do("PUT", "/api/admin/assign", map[string]any{"target": "cyrene", "site": "Straw"}, oh...), 200)
	ok("poll", e.do("PUT", "/api/systems/laptop/poll", map[string]any{"interval_s": 5}, oh...), 200)
	set := e.do("GET", "/api/settings", nil, "Cookie", owner)
	ok("settings get", set, 200)
	ok("settings put", e.do("PUT", "/api/settings", set.body, oh...), 200)
	ok("viewer reads", e.do("GET", "/api/systems", nil, "Cookie", straw), 200)
	ok("refused", e.do("PUT", "/api/systems/laptop/poll", map[string]any{"interval_s": 5}, "Cookie", straw, "X-Requested-With", "fairy"), 403, 404)

	// notifications, as the panel's own watchers add them
	resolved := time.Now().UTC()
	s.Notes.Add(notifications.Event{Kind: "host_offline", Type: "host", Severity: "critical", SystemID: "cyrene", Host: "cyrene",
		Text: "cyrene is offline", Key: "offline:cyrene", Alarm: true})
	s.Notes.Add(notifications.Event{Kind: "update_failed", Type: "update", Severity: "warning", SystemID: "laptop", Host: "laptop",
		Text: "laptop: update failed"})
	s.Notes.Add(notifications.Event{Kind: "temp_high", Type: "temperature", Severity: "warning", SystemID: "laptop", Host: "laptop",
		Text: "laptop: CPU 91 °C", Key: "temp:laptop", Alarm: true, Resolved: &resolved})
	ok("read", e.do("POST", "/api/notifications/read", map[string]any{"all": true}, oh...), 200, 204)
	s.Notes.Add(notifications.Event{Kind: "host_online", Type: "host", Severity: "info", SystemID: "laptop", Host: "laptop", Text: "laptop is back"})
	if err := s.Notes.Flush(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	// UPS transitions (ups-events.jsonl)
	row := func(status string) map[string]any {
		return ups.RowMap(devices.UPSFromVars("ups1", map[string]string{"ups.status": status, "battery.charge": "97"}, ""))
	}
	for _, st := range []string{"OL", "OB", "OL"} {
		p.UPS.UpdateFromAgent("laptop", []map[string]any{row(st)}, false, map[string][]string{"ups1": {"laptop"}}, nil)
	}

	// the admin CLI of that release, on the same data directory
	cliCfg := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yaml")
	y := strings.NewReplacer("data_dir: /var/lib/fairy", "data_dir: "+dataDir, "audit_log: /var/lib/fairy/audit.log",
		"audit_log: "+cfg.AuditLog).Replace(vBeforeConfig)
	if err := os.WriteFile(cliCfg, []byte(y), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cli := func(args ...string) string {
		var o, eb bytes.Buffer
		if code := admin.Main(append([]string{"--config", cliCfg, "--env-file", filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "none.env")}, args...), &o, &eb); code != 0 {
			t.Fatal(args, code, o.String(), eb.String())
		}
		return o.String()
	}
	rawToken := func(out string) string {
		for _, f := range strings.Fields(out) {
			if strings.HasPrefix(f, "fy_") {
				return f
			}
		}
		t.Fatal("no token in", out)
		return ""
	}
	tokSystem := rawToken(cli("tokens", "create", "--name", "home-assistant", "--owner", "system", "--scope", "read"))
	tokStraw := rawToken(cli("tokens", "create", "--name", "straw-script", "--owner", "9a1b77c0-straw-0002", "--sites", "Straw"))
	cli("control", "disable", "--reason", "maintenance")
	cli("control", "enable")
	cli("sites", "assign", "power:desk-plug", "Neptune")
	usersList := cli("users", "list")

	time.Sleep(1200 * time.Millisecond) // the stores write behind
	meta, _ := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"generated_at_unix": time.Now().Unix(), "base_commit": "05b1019", "session_secret": strings.Repeat("s", 48),
		"cookie_name": cookieName, "owner_sub": "3f6c1d2e-owner-0001", "owner_cookie": owner, "viewer_sub": "9a1b77c0-straw-0002",
		"viewer_cookie": straw, "users_list": usersList, "token_system_read": tokSystem, "token_viewer_read": tokStraw,
		"note": "Test fixture: every name, address, token and cookie in this directory is made up. The cookies are signed with session_secret."}, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "generated.json"), append(meta, '\n'), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
